judgment: It is good to hold firm.
Small things can be done; great things cannot.
A flying bird leaves its sound behind:
not fit to go up, fit to go down. Great good.
image: Thunder on the mountain: Small Excess.
So the noble one, in conduct, exceeds in reverence,
lines: Passing your grandfather, meeting your grandmother;
not reaching your ruler, meeting his minister.
Do not pass it by: guard against it.
Close behind, someone may strike you.
The duke shoots with a stringed arrow
and takes the one in the cave.
This is called disaster and harm.

notes.name_en: 小過 a small going-past; paired with 28 Great Excess. Not Wilhelm's 'Preponderance of the Small'.
notes.L5: 密雲不雨自我西郊 repeats 9 J in the Chinese; the English repeats it word for word.
